subject: Re: Kickoff: fast gradient clipping for DP-SGD
body:
Zofia — resourcing.

Staffing: Leilani 50% through the window, Bilal 40% (profiling then integration support), Csilla 25% for the correctness review. And Vera Egede is committed at 60% to this project for June 2026 for the BERT-scale runs and the cost memo — those runs are the deliverable the privacy council actually reads, so I've protected that allocation explicitly.

Compute: the profiling replays (fc1/fc2, emb1, bert1 targets) fit on 8 A100s best-effort; the June BERT-scale comparison wants 64 A100s for about ten days — filed on titan, no reservation needed.

One gap flagged in the repo: peak-memory profiling assumes internal tooling we don't have, so Bilal will wire our own profiler into the get_compute_profile functions in profiling_tools.py.

Heads-up: vulcan maintenance Jun 22-24 doesn't touch us since we're on titan.

Bruno
